response.sql: WITH batting_hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as count FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_batting_hands FROM batting_hand_counts) SELECT bhc.bats, bhc.count, bhc.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share, bhc.count * 1.0 / (t.total_count * 1.0 / t.num_batting_hands) as count_div_avg FROM batting_hand_counts bhc CROSS JOIN totals t
